With `isolate: false`, the module registry is shared per worker, so whichever file's mock/real-module is cached first can leak into another file sharing that worker slot. This is systemic across the codebase, not a one-file fix.

Verified the suite is stable at baseline: 355/355 files, 2660/2660 tests, coverage 94/84/96/96% (above the 85/70/85/85 thresholds). Trading a ~15s CI speedup for occasional flaky test failures isn't worth it here — fixing it properly would require refactoring 28+ files' Node built-in mocks to avoid shared-registry collisions.
